answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking scarce resources on reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond of real value that scales with the number of identities it controls. An attacker who tries to wander across many fake personas must post collateral for every one, turning a inexpensive swarm into an expensive liability. Honest agents recover their stake, while the forging cost of a thousand ivory keys or marble-sealed claims rises faster than any reward.
